title: Aide personnalisée au logement (APL): eligibility of residents of a logement-foyer

source.entry_point: Aides_logement scope ÉligibilitéAidePersonnaliséeLogement, output éligibilité (Python: generated.Aides_logement.eligibilite_aide_personnalisee_logement, Catala 1.3.0)

attributes.name: date_courante
attributes.source: ÉligibilitéAidePersonnaliséeLogement.date_courante (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:378-381). Cut points: aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:1333-1339 (Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon from 2021-01-01); aides_logement/code_construction_reglementaire.catala_fr:5995-6019 (DROM rule for FoyerJeunesTravailleurs… from 2023-04-05); smic/Smic.catala_fr:434-443 and 481-489 (Mayotte SMIC conflict 2024-01-01 to 2024-10-31). The domain starts at 2019-09-01: before that date every input raises NoValue (see FR-APL-1)

attributes.name: type_logement_foyer
attributes.source: LogementFoyer.type_logement, enumeration TypeLogementFoyer (aides_logement/code_construction_reglementaire.catala_fr:3732-3736); read by aides_logement/code_construction_reglementaire.catala_fr:3729-3751 and 5995-6019

attributes.name: conventionne_selon_regles_drom
attributes.source: LogementFoyer.conventionné_selon_règles_drom (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:117-135); read by L861-5-1 (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:1463-1489) in Guadeloupe, Guyane, Martinique, La Réunion and Mayotte

exclusions.description: The type FoyerJeunesTravailleursOuMigrantsConventionnéL353_2Avant1995 is by definition a foyer that signed an L353-2 convention before 1995; L353-2 is in livre III, titre V, chapitre III of the code de la construction, so the foyer cannot be unconventioned under that chapter
exclusions.source: aides_logement/code_construction_reglementaire.catala_fr:3712-3727 (R832-20 3°: foyers "ayant fait l'objet d'une convention, prévue à l'article L. 353-2, signée avant le 1er janvier 1995") and 3732-3736 (enumeration)

exclusions.description: A convention under the DROM rules of L861-5-1 exists only for foyers in Guadeloupe, Guyane, Martinique, La Réunion and Mayotte
exclusions.source: aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:1463-1489 (L861-5-1, which defines that convention for these five territories only)

demandeur.nationalité.why: the only nationality value that meets the nationality condition in every territory, including Mayotte where Française fails (L861-5 1°, FR-APL-1); no official test maps onto this table, so nothing ties it to Exemple1's Française

logement.mode_occupation.value: RésidentLogementFoyer {logement_foyer_jeunes_travailleurs: faux, date_conventionnement: |2000-01-01|, construit_application_loi_1957_12_III: faux, redevance: 400 €, catégorie_équivalence_loyer_d842_16: AutresPersonnes, every other boolean faux; type_logement and the three convention booleans from the attributes}
logement.mode_occupation.why: the fields that are not attributes are read only by the amount computation

every other ménage and demandeur field.value: as in the official test Exemple1 (aides_logement/tests/tests_eligibilite_apl.catala_fr:16-107): date_courante |2020-03-10|, résidence Métropole, Mariés |2010-11-26|, three EnfantÀCharge (born 2001-01-01 Après with études, 2009-01-01 Pendant, 2012-01-01 Pendant; French, 0 € pay, no shared custody, a_déjà_ouvert_droit_aux_allocations_familiales vrai), prestations [AllocationSoutienEnfantHandicapé; ComplémentFamilial; AllocationsFamiliales], 1 other occupant, Locataire of a BailleurSocial conventionné (loyer 750 €, RLS 0 €, every other Location boolean faux, PasDeChangement), Zone1, résidence principale, décent, 80 m², propriétaire Autre, usufruit Autre, not let to third parties, no IFI, no unborn child, not R844-4; demandeur born 1970-05-02, Française, with every other boolean faux
every other ménage and demandeur field.why: same household as the other FR-APL tables

notes: Sub-table 4 of 5 of FR-APL (amount computation out of scope). No official test of tests_eligibilite_apl.catala_fr concerns a logement-foyer, so official_examples.csv has no data row.
